summary: Final cross-LLM plan review over cumulative diff: promotes drift/spec-gap findings into REVIEW-TASKS, auto-amends amendment proposals, renders amendment brief/run-brief, finalizes tier2 context, and then runs memory review.

entry_points.summary: Validates .review_state.json against HEAD; fast-forwards to Phase 4 or deletes stale state.
Optional runtime.pre_review cycle before consultant dispatch; separate from final review authority.
Parallel consultant-primary and consultant-secondary final-review calls.
Canonical classes and dispositions for promoted findings.
Unconditionally auto-applies amendable spec_gap amendment_proposal tasks via /z-amend --skip-user-gate.
Builds corrections and approach_concerns JSON, renders archive amendment-brief.md.
Skips brief only when both corrections and approach_concerns are empty.
Finalizes tier2-context and significance gate for z-doc-rationale recommendations.
Sets outcome/next/approach and renders final chat/push via run-brief.
Prefers archive amendment-brief.md over findings.md and REVIEW-TASKS for approach extraction.
Runs run-memory-review, review-agent, and optional axiom-extractor candidate flow.

invariants: Pre-review cycle never replaces final consultants.
Every promoted finding has Class and Disposition.
spec_gap amendment_proposal tasks are auto-amended without per-finding prompt.
Code changes are never auto-implemented by Phase 6.5.
Phase 6.6 skip requires both lists empty.
Run Brief owns final user-facing prose.
A resume with mismatched HEAD or missing artifact files is always treated as stale and re-run from Phase 0.
gotchas: Phase 6.5 header says severity-based but current rule applies blocker/major/minor amendment proposals alike.
A clean review writes shipped.md and omits REVIEW-TASKS; Phase 6.5/6.6 then have nothing to do.
Phase 7 memory review can dispatch axiom-extractor alongside review-agent when AXIOM_READY is present; axiom-extractor proposes only, never auto-approves.
Line numbers for phase headings drift by tens of lines between edits (e.g. this refresh moved every entry point by ~89 lines) — re-verify via grep before citing, don't assume a fixed offset.
